title: MAIRA-2: Grounded Radiology Report Generation
method: Generates atomic report sentences with optional bounding boxes from current, lateral, prior images and text context
evidence: Separates logical precision/recall from spatial grounding precision/recall
Demonstrates grounded medical generation with multi-image context
Uses normalized spatial references suitable for structured evidence packets
limitations: Sentence-level evaluation can miss internal or partial errors
Grounding does not establish clinical readiness
Chest radiography is narrower than Med-CMR
transfer_decision: Use atomic evidence statements and boxes, but independently score localization, observation correctness, entailment, and final answers.
